newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint fluctuates, ends stable against dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint fluctuates, ends stable against dlr.

text.p: The forint fluctuated in slow afternoon trade against the dollar, tracking the mark's fall and rise, but ending unchanged from its morning close of 165.40/50, dealers said.
"We closely tracked the dollar/mark in relatively thin trading," said Andras Szanto of Europai Kereskedelmi Bank.
Within the central bank's 4.5 percent wide floating intervention range, the forint stayed stable, roughly 15 fillers away from its resistance level, he added.
Forint sellers slightly outnumbered buyers and the imbalance might grow tomorrow, said Commerzbank's Elke Szanto.
"The overnight rate will probably fall from today's 28 percent to something more like 22 percent, which would encourage people to go long (on dollars)" she said.
On the Budapest Commodities Exchange's currency section, turnover was a sluggish 3.13 billion forints, with three quarters coming from Swiss franc futures. Dollar volume was a distant second.
